title: Synapxe
description: Cyberpunk Technical Apparel Storefront — Engineered Urban Shell Systems, 3-Layer ePTFE Storm Shells, and Modular Techwear.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Three.js 3D · Tailwind v4 · Canvas Rain

sections.title: Quick-Size Matrix
sections.summary: Selectable \`[S] [M] [L] [XL]\` buttons directly on the card. Clicking a size updates a live stock badge (e.g., \`STATUS: 2 UNITS LEFT IN SECTOR\`) and enables the \`+ ADD TO LOADOUT\` button.

sections.title: Colorway Swatch Pill
sections.summary: Toggle between \`STEALTH BLACK\`, \`OXIDE SLATE\`, and \`NEON NOIR\` (applies a subtle CSS hue/contrast shift to the product image and updates the variant SKU).

sections.title: Spec Telemetry Bars
sections.summary: 3 mini progress bars at the bottom of each card visualizing Waterproof rating, Breathability, and Weight.

sections.title: Layer 01 (Outer)
sections.summary: \`200D Ballistic Cordura® + DWR Fluorocarbon-Free Coating\` (Deflects external rain/wind).

sections.title: Layer 02 (Core)
sections.summary: \`Microporous Black ePTFE Hydrophobic Membrane\` (9 billion pores per sq inch).

customCodeBlocks.title: Synapxe Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: Synapxe Interactive Runtime Bridge
customCodeBlocks.description: Loads three in page footer custom code with prefers-reduced-motion guard.
